name: tradein_food
_comment: Wave 12 item 6b: the trade-in's second data point. Pilot w12_tradein_food: Kit Mass Roomy 100 (cost 100,000) with NO outfits and 50 t of food. Shipyard, the first cell (Kit Mass Roomy 300), Buy Ship: the confirm dialog's Trade-In. 25,000 = the hull only; 26,250 = the hull + the food at 100 / t. (Wave 11: 27,500 with 5,000 of plain outfits, 2 Keeps and 50 t of food aboard.)
